follow-up time: Average of 5.6 ± 2.7 months to pregnancy after HIFU treatment
cohort: 78 patients with uterine fibroids who wished to become pregnant and underwent HIFU treatment between April 2011 and March 2016 at Chongqing Haifu Hospital in China.
finding: HIFU treatment was found to be effective in treating uterine fibroids in women who desired pregnancy, resulting in a significantly reduced time to pregnancy and improved fertility outcomes in those with previous infertility or pregnancy complications, without increasing obstetric risks.
mod_finding: Out of the 80 pregnancies, there were 15 full-term normal deliveries and 56 caesarean sections.
